title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27): New layout information fields in the aggregated metadata sheet for the Excel layout template (Object caption, Local date, and UTC timezone offset)
summary: Business Central 2025 wave 2 introduces three new layout information fields in the Excel layout template's aggregated metadata sheet: object caption, local date, and UTC timezone offset. This enhancement helps developers better configure Excel report layouts by providing additional contextual information.
key_points: Three new fields added to the Aggregated Metadata sheet in Excel layouts: object caption, local date, and UTC timezone offset
These fields support Excel report layout creation and design alongside existing dataset definition tasks
The feature is available in BC27 public preview but not yet documented in the official release plan
Word layouts do not yet include these new metadata fields despite having report metadata access capability
